messages:
incident-bot: Pager: elevated 5xx rate on /v1/generate (dedicated pool: dedicated-evg-1). First spike at ~2249004318. Severity: P1.

alex: I’m on pager. grabbing logs + pmap.

sam: seeing a lot of cudaMalloc failures and repeated arena allocation retries in the runtime logs. message sample: `cudaErrorMemoryAllocation` then `arena_reslice: couldnt_find_slab`.

maria: metrics: tail latency jump + queue depth growth on cont-batching path. KV-cache size increased 4x on a subset of hosts. link: https://grafana/redwood/d/kv-cache?orgId=1&var-pool=dedicated-evg-1

alex: confirmed customer-facing errors. ACME_Corp has ~30% error rate on generate. Support ticket opened.

devops: are we sure it's fragmentation and not a leak? pmap + nvidia-smi show free GPU memory fragmented across many small allocations.

sam: logs show continuous-batching amortized allocations creating many small KV entries, then slab exhaustion triggers fallback to cudaMalloc which fails. Pattern: batches with many short prefixes causing lots of tiny cache writes.

jordan: immediate mitigation proposals: 1) reduce continuous batch max_tokens, 2) throttle prefix caching for new sessions, 3) route new requests to warm fallback model (smaller mem) while we patch.

alex: doing 1 + 3 now. applying config change to runtime fleet:

```
PATCH /api/v1/runtime/config
{
  "cont_batch.max_tokens": 512,
  "kv.cache_prefix_enabled": false
}
```

alex: rolling patch to pool dedicated-evg-1 via infra pipeline (will update when each host acknowledges).

maria: started diverting non-critical traffic to hosted fallback and reduced concurrency for ACME_Corp. latency improved a bit on hosts patched.

devops: starting a soft restart of arena process on worst hosts (host-12, host-19). command: `systemctl restart redwood-arena` — will do one at a time.

sam: while restarts run, I can also push a hotfix to allocator behaviour to prefer larger slab allocations for cont-batch small allocation patterns. quick patch below (runtime branch):

```
// allocator heuristic tweak
if (request_type == CONT_BATCH && avg_alloc_size < 512) {
  prefer_slab_size = max(prefer_slab_size, 4 * avg_alloc_size);
}
```

sam: compiling and will build canary image for 2 hosts.

katie: customer comms: telling ACME_Corp we have an active mitigation (throttles + routing) and ETA ~45-90m for full resolution. logging all affected request ids and attaching to the ticket.

ryan: note: enabling slab compaction may be heavy — avoid global compaction unless hosts are idle. prefer restart + heuristic tweak.

incident-bot: Update: config rollout started at 2249004680, 4/12 hosts patched.

alex: patched 4 hosts manually, error rate on those hosts dropped from 30% -> 3%. Good signal. continuing roll.

sam: canary build successfully running on host-12 with allocator tweak. memory fragmentation metrics show lower small-chunk churn.

devops: rolled host-19 restart complete. host health checks OK.

maria: after 30m, cluster-wide error rate is down to ~7% from peak 28%. still some hotspots on 3 hosts.

jordan: for short-term safety, enabling model fallback for heavy prefixes. runbook step: set route_policy:downgrade_on_fragmentation=true on pool.

alex: applied downgrade_on_fragmentation. traffic towards smaller model increased 12%. tail latency for downgraded requests stable.

sam: opened PR for allocator patch (runtime#4923). request reviews: @devops @alex. PR includes tests simulating many tiny KV writes and asserts no catastrophic fragmentation.

devops: schedule: complete rollout of config + restart remaining hosts (in groups) over next 45m. monitoring closely.

katie: raising alert to SEs to proactively message customers with seq ids for any failed calls. recording all upstream responses for postmortem.

incident-bot: Note: customer-impact flag set = true. Incident channel for RCA: #incidents-2249004321-rca.

alex: final steps: 1) finish rollout 2) keep cont_batch at conservative 512 for 24h 3) merge allocator PR after +48h of canary stability 4) schedule follow-up to add workload-aware slab sizing into optimizer.

maria: logging timeline and saved heap/kv snapshots for hosts impacted.

sam: will follow-up with perf regression test and schedule dedicated end-to-end eval to prevent recurrence.

devops: rolling restart done; all hosts healthy.

incident-bot: Incident status -> mitigated at 2249009022. Postmortem task created, assignees: sam, alex, maria, devops.

alex: thanks everyone. will draft postmortem + customer notes. :thumbsup:
